hardware.variant: One assembled kit with operator-reported CoreBoard V1.2.

inputs.name: RAM firmware FIT with SPL, OpenSBI and U-Boot
inputs.revision: U-Boot 2026.10; OpenSBI 1.9; existing RAM boot firmware

inputs.name: Stagecheck littlefs RAM root image
inputs.revision: EmberBSD static-base-v2; packed with the published littlefs makefs backend

inputs.name: littlefs VFS acceptance checker
inputs.revision: Built from the same EmberBSD littlefs source revision and staged in the RAM root

scenario: On one operator-reported V1.2 sample, RAM-load the firmware, ESP_MOSAICO_LITTLEFS kernel FIT and littlefs root image; boot single-user, remount the root read-write with the system mount_littlefs helper, run the staged full littlefs VFS checker, then run sync.
expected: The kernel mounts the littlefs RAM root, accepts a read-write remount, and the VFS checker and sync complete successfully.
observed: The kernel reached the single-user root shell with littlefs mounted on the RAM root. `/sbin/mount_littlefs -o update,rw root_device /` returned 0, and `/sbin/mount` reported the root as littlefs. `/bin/littlefs-vfs-check-memory-current /` passed its full create/write/sync, mmap/msync, metadata, symlink/readlink, truncate/fsync, open-file rename/unlink and cleanup checks. `/bin/sync` returned 0. No NOR write or persistent filesystem access was part of this run.
limits: One operator-reported V1.2 sample; other units and board revisions were not tested.
The filesystem image and checker ran from RAM. This does not establish NOR read/write, a persistent littlefs root, or data retention across power cycles.
The run did not test NAND, full-range PSRAM read/write, networking, or sustained reliability.
The UART capture and device identifiers remain private; no raw logs, credentials or device identifiers are published.
